item.title: Escaping Single Quotes in PHP for MySQL
item.description: When developing PHP applications that interact with MySQL databases, it’s crucial to handle user input carefully to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities. One common mistake is not properly escaping single quotes. This article explains the importance of escaping single quotes in PHP for MySQL queries and provides guidance on how to do it correctly. The Risk: SQL Injection Vulnerabilities Failure to escape single quotes in user input can lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities.
